title: Jesus... Why Can't I Just Enjoy This? 🙂
topic: good things finally arrived for him and he cannot enjoy any of it, always waiting for the catch

bible.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why can't I just enjoy this? 🙂

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Offer letter came. Friends booked a table. First thought: what's about to go wrong?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You've been braced for bad news so long that good news feels like a trick.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Last time something good came, it left fast. So I keep one foot out the door.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Keep the memory. Drop the guard. This gift isn't a trap with a bow on it.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Sit at the table tonight. Eat the whole meal. It's allowed.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What good thing are you scared to enjoy? 👇
